procedure_grammar.call: only when a supplied AbstractionLibrary reference exists

argument_choices.call: one atom per installed abstraction ID

branching_choices: none in AcquisitionProcedure; UniversalMechanismSearch has exactly three fixed strategies
loop_choices: none in procedure grammar; executor has a fixed 256 procedure-step execution ceiling
call_targets: sorted installed abstraction IDs when library is non-nil
composition: ordered concatenation of atoms up to maxSteps; call recursively executes referenced procedure
pruning: Marshal/decode validity, executor errors, no observable future search change, hidden/regression behavioral failure
resource_limits: candidate artifact receives spec.ResourceLimits; selector cost uses candidate Resources.Compute and ExperimentBudget only
acquired_reference_depth: unbounded in principle subject to cycle detection and 256 execution steps, but only installed references are legal
critical_reachability_finding: The grammar can express a call to A1 if A1 is already installed. However the current recursive V3 acquisition path calls AutonomousMethodImprovement with lib=nil, so its actual generated candidate set contains no acquired calls.
